main_asks: Narrow scope to communications providers and exclude non-communications entities

answer.quote: We believe that amending the definition to narrow the scope will help ensure that the legislation remains focused on its intended objectives.

answer.quote: For these reasons, I respectfully urge the Committee and Parliament to support and advance Bill C-22 without delay.
